headline: Frontiers in Quantum Information, Theory, and Systems
summary: Today's literature covers a wide spectrum of quantum physics and computer science, ranging from practical platforms and information retrieval schemes to fundamental limits in channel tomography, conformal field theory, and spacetime emergence.

themes.title: Quantum Systems and Computation
themes.body: New developments feature scalable platforms like Qyantram achieving sub-millisecond verification on large qubit layouts, alongside novel entanglement-based schemes for quantum private information retrieval on forest graphs.

themes.title: Foundational Quantum Theory and Statistical Mechanics
themes.body: Researchers explore near-boundary optimal bounds in quantum channel tomography, replica-free expansions of vacuum mutual information in conformal field theories, and Lee-Yang zero properties for q-deformed oscillators.

themes.title: Emergent Spacetime and Hardware Enhancements
themes.body: Studies demonstrate how artificial agents trained on quantum tasks can autonomously learn the causal structure of spacetime, while nanophotonic structures enable single-pass stochastic cooling for electron microscopy.

connections.body: Both Qyantram and the work on quantum private information retrieval leverage advanced entanglement and state management to optimize complex multi-qubit and multi-server quantum routing and communication tasks.
